_comment_scope: Portal LHCI config. Per performance.md §1 portal pages are audited on MOBILE form factor (Lucia persona, simulated slow 4G, 4x CPU slowdown). Phase G ships a no-router shell rendering `/` only; Phase H wires React Router and adds per-route assertions matching performance.md §2 (TTI ≤ 1.8 s, LCP ≤ 1.5 s, CLS ≤ 0.05, score ≥ 0.9 on portal `/` mobile).
_comment_timing_thresholds: Numeric timing thresholds (TTI/LCP) are deferred to Phase H — they require a working bootstrap which needs BFF /config available. Static-dist LHCI on Phase G shell stops at the `Bootstrap failed: /config HTTP 404` error message, so LCP measures the error <pre> element. Until BFF or MSW is wired into the CI LHCI run, this config asserts only the stable signals: categories:accessibility + categories:best-practices + CLS (which is robust to bootstrap state). Timing assertions stay listed (as `warn`) for visibility in PR comments.

assert._comment_blocking: Blocking assertions — robust against the Phase G bootstrap state. CLS is structural (layout shift = bad regardless of backend). Accessibility + best-practices catch obvious regressions.
assert._comment_warn_phase_h: Timing thresholds (TTI, LCP, score) graduate to `error` in Phase H when route-level bootstrap is reachable. Values match performance.md §2 portal `/` mobile.
